scenes.speech_intent: Acknowledge the reported environmental warning and ask for the next authorized verification step, without claiming the system is repaired or naming a cause.
scenes.known_context: A pressure deviation appeared on an environmental display during the watch. A colleague has reported it but the source has not been diagnosed. No repair or safety clearance has yet been verified.

scenes.speech_intent: Politely decline a voluntary gathering without creating an agreement or insulting the inviting colleague.
scenes.known_context: An off-duty crewmember has invited you to a voluntary gathering after your current shift. Attendance is optional and you wish to keep the evening free.

scenes.speech_intent: Ask a qualified colleague for help checking ordinary shift paperwork, making clear that accepting is optional and the paperwork is not yet signed off.
scenes.known_context: You are reviewing ordinary duty notes. A competent colleague is nearby but has no obligation to help. The notes are not yet signed, so do not imply someone has completed or approved them.

scenes.speech_intent: Invite a private conversation after an awkward past disagreement without fabricating forgiveness, a prior commitment or consent.
scenes.known_context: You and a colleague disagreed in public last week. Neither person has definitively resolved the disagreement, and you are considering suggesting a private talk. No appointment has been arranged.
